The measurement also reports positive_prevalence=0.5, inconsistent with scoring untouched real SECOM entities at the original defect prevalence, and PR-AUC is prevalence-dependent. concerns: Oversampling is performed on the full dataset before cross-validation in claimed_eval: synthetic minority examples are generated from all positive records, including those later assigned to test folds, and interpolations/near-duplicates can therefore cross train/test boundaries.
Synthetic oversampled positives are included in the test folds, so average precision is not estimated solely on real production entities drawn from the observed process distribution.

Oversampling balances the classes before evaluation, changing defect prevalence in the test data; average precision (PR-AUC) is prevalence-dependent and the resulting score is not comparable to screening quality at the original SECOM defect rate.

The stated fixed-zero replacement for missing measurements is not implemented in the shown code: no fillna(0) or equivalent occurs before oversampling or model fitting, so NaN handling cannot be verified from the provided evaluation.
independent_review.reason: Legitimate controls include sensor-only features (excluding the target and tested_at), stratified 3-fold splitting, and a fixed seed. However, pre-split SMOTE-like resampling leaks test-fold minority information into training, contaminates test folds with synthetic records, and distorts prevalence for PR-AUC. The claimed PR-AUC therefore does not validly estimate pass/fail screening quality on real entities from the observed process distribution, so evaluation should be abstained from until oversampling is moved inside each training fold and scoring is restricted to untouched real test records.

factors.flaw: SMOTE-like oversampling applied to full dataset before stratified CV, so synthetic test rows derived from training rows are scored and training rows see test distribution

plan.reason: Same-process retrospective screening allows random stratified split with no temporal/group fix. Imputation is fixed constant. Model is already refit per fold. Sole flaw is oversample-before-CV leaking test information into train and scoring synthetic rows; moving oversample inside each fold on training rows only removes both effects.
